source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to space and environment (PDF 169-170).

blocks.text: Space (khala) aur environment (mahol) do aham aur aapas mein jure hue shobe (fields) hain. In se hum kainat (universe) aur apni zameen dono ko samajhte hain. Space zameen ki atmosphere (hawa ki tah) se aage ka woh ilaqa hai jahan planets, stars aur galaxies jaise tamam celestial bodies (aasmani ajsam) maujood hain aur gravity aur electromagnetic radiation ke zariye aik doosre par asar dalte hain. Environment woh physical, chemical aur biological halaat hain jin mein jandaar aur bejaan cheezen rehti aur aik doosre par asar karti hain. Is mein hawa, pani, zameen, climate (lambe arse ka mausam), ecosystems aur woh tamam qudrati amal shamil hain jo zameen par zindagi ko sahara dete hain. Is chapter mein hum dekhenge ke stars energy kaise kharij karte hain (luminosity), cosmic faasle napne ke liye standard candles aur redshift jaise auzaar kaise kaam aate hain, aur radiation ke laws (qawaneen) stars ka temperature aur size andaza lagane mein kaise madad dete hain. Hum yeh bhi seekhenge ke zameen ka climate system hawa, pani, barf, zameen aur zindagi ke aapas ke amal se kaise chalta hai, aur yeh sab Sooraj ki energy, hawa aur samandar ki circulation (gardish) par kaise asar lete hain.
